_comment: Smallest working NLTE config. NLTE is turned on once, via grid.synthesis.calculation_mode='NLTE'; nlte.enabled and the NLTE info file are derived/defaulted for you.
_nlte_quickstart: Model atoms + binary departure grids land under input_files/nlte_data/{model_atoms,departure_grids}.
2. Point the two path headers in DATA/SPECIES_LTE_NLTE.dat at those folders (the shipped file points at an HPC path), and set the species you want to 'nlte'.
The pipeline runs the same NLTE preflight automatically before synthesis; pass --skip-nlte-preflight to bypass it.
For per-abundance ASCII departures instead of binary grids, add an nlte_ascii_departures block (see config_regular_grid_nlte_fe.example.json).

turbospectrum._note: Only the inputs every synthesis needs. NLTE adds nothing here — calculation_mode above is the single switch, and the info file defaults to DATA/SPECIES_LTE_NLTE.dat.

paths._paths_note: Inline turbospectrum paths resolve against project_root (the repo root), NOT relative to this file. Leave model_atmosphere_path empty to auto-locate input_files/model_atmospheres/1D/marcs_standard_comp (also handles the nested-extract layout).
